title: Slushie Bar Salts Watermelon Kiwi Apple 10ml E-Liquid
description: Watermelon Kiwi Apple from Slushie Bar Salts is a delicious e-liquid that blends the sweet, succulent taste of the juiciest Watermelons with the tangy, tropical flavour of Kiwi and the crisp, fresh flavour of Apple for a truly invigorating vaping experience. This Nic Salt blend delivers an intense burst of authentic fruit flavours, each offering a refreshing and satisfying vape with every puff. The e-liquid starts with the light and luscious flavour of fresh Watermelon, providing a mouth-watering base. This is then enhanced by the zesty and exotic flavour of Kiwi, adding a touch of tartness and complexity to the mix. The finish is the unmistakably sharp, clean and bright flavour of Apple, adding a hint of crispness and balance to the e-liquid. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
